title: School locker / cubby clear
summary: Leaving mid-term with lockers, cubbies, and lost-property shelves still holding kit — clear days, padlock cuts, and how locker clear collides with bus cancel, device return, and movers week.

sections.title: Inventory every locker and cubby early
sections.body: Primary cubbies, secondary lockers, PE cage cages, music practice rooms, and art dry-racks often hold more than the classroom desk. Lost-property shelves keep unlabeled kits for weeks. Walk every space the week you decide to leave — not the morning after the last attendance day.
bullets: Photograph each assigned locker number and combination before packing week
Ask form tutors for shared CCA / drama storage the child uses
Check lost-property once mid-week and once on the last attendance morning

sections.title: Padlocks, combinations, and cut-off fees
sections.body: Forgotten combinations become facilities cut fees or delayed clearances. Some schools will not issue final reports or device clearances until lockers are empty and padlocks removed. Book a cut appointment before movers week if the combination is already lost.
bullets: Test the padlock the weekend before clear day
Ask facilities the published cut / replacement fee before you book flights
Do not leave a cut padlock on the locker — remove and bin it

sections.title: Same-week stack with bus, devices, and pets
sections.body: Locker clear, bus cancel, school device return, and pet export paperwork often land in one fortnight. Sequence so the child still has a ride on clear day, and so locker kit is not scheduled after the service lift is already booked for packing. Pet quarantine cash is a separate float — do not raid locker fee money for AVS titres.
bullets: Put locker clear, bus last-ride, and device return on one family calendar
Pair with /tools/pet-quarantine-float if animals still need export cash
Keep one adult free for school-office errands on clear week

sections.title: Sibling and shared cubbies
sections.body: Families with two children sharing a cubby or PE cage need an explicit split list. Leaving one child’s textbooks in a sibling’s locker becomes a deposit fight after you fly. Label bags before clear morning.
bullets: Make a written split list for shared PE / music storage
Re-label the surviving sibling’s cubby after the departing child clears
Do not leave meds or epi-pens in a shared locker overnight

sections.title: Library, canteen, and print holds
sections.body: Locker clear is physical — library holds, canteen top-ups, and print credit are digital. Some schools block report release until library items and locker fees clear together. Export canteen balances while the parent portal still accepts your login.
bullets: Clear library loans the same week as the locker
Screenshot canteen / print balances before portal access dies
Ask whether unspent canteen credit refunds to the bank on file

sections.title: Cash float: cut fees vs pet export
sections.body: Padlock cuts, lost-locker fees, and last canteen top-ups are small next to pet quarantine or titre cash — but they hit the same week as movers deposits. Keep a dedicated SGD float so a facilities invoice does not raid AVS or flight money.
bullets: Total published locker / cut fees before resignation week
Pay school portals while Singapore cards and PayNow still work
